Final for Publication

TYPE 1 NARRATIVE & PLANS
2653 W. Monroe Street, Chicago IL
Zoning Amendment Application
From M1-2 to RM-5

1. Project Narrative:

The Applicant, Lotus Property Group LLC, is the owner of the property located at 2653 West
Monroe Street, Chicago Illinois (Property). The Property is currently vacant land zoned as M1-2.
with neighboring residential properties.

The Applicant seeks to improve upon the existing vacant land by constructing a proposed 4-story
4-dwelling unit type IIIA residential building with two off-street parking spaces, similar to the
adjacent 3-story, 4-dwelling unit building at 2655 W. Monroe, which was constructed by the
Applicant after securing a map amendment from M1-2 to RM-5 in alignment with the RM-5
zoning district of the parcels directly across the street, to the north, of the subject property.
Therefore, the Applicant seeks a zoning amendment from the existing M1-2 zoning district to an
RM-5 zoning district.

The Property is currently vacant land and is a standard Chicago city lot measuring 25 ft x 125 ft =
3125 sq.ft.. The proposed building square footage is 5976 sq.ft. (1200 sq.ft./unit). The proposed
total lot coverage/building footprint is 1460 sq.ft. The proposed building height is 46ft-2in. Two
off-street parking spaces will be provided at the rear of the Property.

Though the Property is currently zoned M1-2, the Property is in a residential area with
neighboring residential properties, with RM-5 zoned parcels across the street in the North
direction. A map amendment to permit a zoning classification of RM-5 is ideal and consistent
with surrounding properties.

2. Bulk and Density Description:

a) Floor area ratio: 1.9
b) Density (lot area per dwelling unit): 1200 sq.ft.
c) Off-street parking: 2 proposed
d) Setbacks existing: Front: 15 feet

Rear: 30 feet

Side: East 3 feet

West 2 feet

e) Building height: 41ft-10in (to the parapet is 46ft-2in)

Seeking all relief necessary, as allowed by code, for the attached plans.
